messages:
Sam B: Thanks for joining the security/all-hands — quick public follow-ups I promised to post here. I have four big asks: SOC2 evidence export timeline, KMS BYOK/HSM status, clarification on VPC connectivity options (PrivateLink vs Transit GW), and audit-log retention/long-term export. Tagging folks.

Maya R: Great, thanks Sam. Will answer SOC2 + evidence export first.

Maya R: SOC2 evidence bundle: we’ll publish a self-serve export in the console by end of Q2. It will include artifact mappings, policy copies, and per-tenant access logs.

Jonah P: For the interim, ops can generate a manual export. dm me if you need a one-off.

Sam B: Is the manual export automated script we gave to customers?

Jonah P: Kind of — internal script, not yet hardened for public. Example command we use:

```bash
python tools/generate_evidence.py --tenant <tenant-id> --start 2025-01-01 --end 2025-03-31 
# outputs: s3://redwood-internal-snapshots/<tenant>/soc2-bundle.zip
```

Emily T: KMS/BYOK update: procurement for HSM-backed BYOK is greenlit. Expected pilot with 2 customers mid-Q3. Key things: HSM attestation, KMS rotation docs, and cross-region key policies.

Ricardo H: From infra: integrating HSM vendor is ~6–8 weeks of engineering work after contracts. We'll spin up a dedicated KMS cluster in the non-prod env first.

Sam B: Any changes to customer-facing API or just a backend key swap?

Emily T: No API changes for customers who don’t BYOK. BYOK customers will get a new binding flow: provide CSR -> we provision HSM slot -> attestation -> import. Docs + UI flow planned.

Lead Security: On compliance: ISO timeline runs parallel to SOC2. We’re preparing the evidence map now; expect ISO readiness assessment in Q4.

Maya R: Back to audit logs retention: default retention is 90 days in the console. We will add long-term export to your S3 (configurable) as a paid add-on by mid-Q3.

Sam B: Is there an SLA for evidence exports and log delivery?

Maya R: SLA for evidence exports is 72 hours for scheduled exports once the feature is GA. For long-term exports to customer S3, delivery is eventual but we target <1 hour batching during normal operations.

Jonah P: For teams needing immediate access today, we can create a signed S3 export (manual) within 24 hours. File format: zipped newline-delimited JSON with gzip.

Sam B: VPC connectivity — PrivateLink vs Transit GW question from the product team: what should customers choose?

Ricardo H: Short answer: PrivateLink for per-customer private endpoints and simpler security posture. Transit GW (or VPC peering) for high-throughput multi-VPC topologies. PrivateLink is lower blast radius but more per-account configuration.

Emily T: Timeline: PrivateLink GA in hosted for a subset of regions mid-Q3. Transit GW patterns are documented in the private deployment repo now.

Sam B: Does PrivateLink support audit log streaming to customer-owned endpoints?

Ricardo H: Yes — once PrivateLink is established we’ll stream audit events to your configured S3 or Kinesis endpoint over the private connection.

Maya R: A few compliance Qs from folks: 1) Data residency options? 2) Retention hooks for e-discovery?

Lead Security: 1) Data residency: you can pin region for hosted models; private deployments are fully within your VPC. 2) For e-discovery we’ll add retention hold APIs in Q4.

Sam B: Can we get a small office hours to walk customers through the BYOK flow and evidence exports?

OpsBot: @here Office hours created: Security Office Hours — BYOK & Evidence Exports. Wed Jul 9 15:00 UTC. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/officehours-SEC-0725

Maya R: I’ll run the SOC2 export demo in that session and post slides after.

Emily T: Action item: engineering to post BYOK spec draft in /docs/private by next week.

Jonah P: Action item: ops to prepare one-off export runbook and a volunteer list for manual support.

Ricardo H: Action item: infra to publish PrivateLink region roll-out plan and expected capacity limits.

Sam B: Thanks all. If you want to follow up privately ping me or book time on my calendar. :thumbsup:

Maya R: Quick note — will attach a simple checklist in the thread after the office hours for SOC2 evidence reviewers.

Lead Security: Will coordinate ISO evidence mapping with Maya and Emily next Tuesday.

Jonah P: FYI: if anyone needs the internal script now I can sanitize it and add a `--public-ready` flag.

Ricardo H: Posted infra doc: https://confluence.redwood.internal/vpc/private-link-plan — feedback welcome.

Sam B: Awesome thread, appreciate the clear owners and timelines.

OpsBot: Reaction summary — :thumbsup: 9, :eyes: 4, :raised_hands: 2
